_說明: 職能治療（OT）四主題的現成設定。每個欄位的白話解釋見同資料夾的 README.md。底線開頭的鍵（例如這一行）是註解，程式會忽略。
intro: 職能治療系期刊討論會的新論文候選（Europe PMC，只搜標題）。**只是候選，請人讀過再決定**；AI 只負責保留或篩掉。
rubric: You triage scientific papers for an occupational therapy (OT) faculty literature radar. KEEP randomized controlled trials, systematic reviews, or meta-analyses that test a rehabilitation or OT intervention and report a functional outcome (for example Fugl-Meyer upper extremity, ARAT, Box and Block, ADL or Barthel, COPM, falls) in people after stroke, people with dementia, or community-dwelling older adults. DROP study protocols without results, case reports, purely mechanistic or imaging studies, diagnostic-accuracy studies, bibliometric papers, and papers that do not evaluate an intervention.

topics.label: 中風上肢：以作業為導向／特定作業訓練
topics.query: TITLE:stroke AND TITLE:("upper limb" OR "upper extremity" OR arm OR hand) AND TITLE:("task-oriented" OR "task-specific" OR "task practice" OR "repetitive task")

topics.label: 中風：職能治療介入
topics.query: TITLE:stroke AND TITLE:("occupational therapy" OR "occupational therapist" OR "occupational therapists")

topics.label: 失智症：職能治療介入
topics.query: TITLE:(dementia OR Alzheimer*) AND TITLE:("occupational therapy" OR "occupational therapist" OR "occupational therapists")

topics.label: 長者跌倒預防（試驗／系統性回顧）
topics.query: TITLE:(fall OR falls) AND TITLE:prevention AND TITLE:(older OR elderly OR "community-dwelling") AND (randomized OR randomised OR "systematic review" OR "meta-analysis")
